cases.name: Kylie Toberman
cases.about: Kylie had taken up wrestling in her junior high school and had been recently voted as the team’s “most improved wrestler.” Her biological mother, Megan Zeller, said that her daughter was brilliant and sassy with a love for animals and her sisters.
cases.narrative:
On 11/14/2025, police discovered her body in a blue tote inside an RV behind her home, where she lived with her adoptive mother, Donna Toberman, and sisters.

Prosecutors say Rivera sexually assaulted Kylie in a car, strangled her with jumper cables. The charges said he then put her body in a blue tote bag inside his RV to try to hide the crime.
